product.title: Waipi’o on Horseback: Mountain Ocean Views Working Cattle Ranch

description.text: Explore Waipio on horseback from a Kona-area Big Island itinerary with this small-group guided ride through a working cattle ranch and farm. Follow your guide through a traditional land division that stretches from the mountain to the ocean, while enjoying the views, looking for wildlife, and learning about the ranch's history and Hawaiian land stewardship. Stops include Waipio Ranch Check-In, Working Cattle Ranch Trails, Mountain Ocean Viewpoint, Traditional Land Division Ride. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Kona's coastline, volcanic highlands, coffee country, and island landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Kona who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
